small_guidance:

- Output spatial size S = (16+4)*(32+4)*(32+4) = 25920 per (N,C); current single-program-per-(N,C) reduction is fine — try persistent kernel with 2D tiling (program per N, loop over C) to reuse loads across channels if memory-bound.
- Ensure x is in channels_last_3d before the reduction so the C-dim is contiguous; this enables vectorized loads when fusing with the conv output.
